text:
maya: Quick riff — building a compact benchmark narrative for the small-launch path. Goal: one short blog post, three reproducible charts, a 25m webinar (tight), and clear inbound routing so AEs only get high-intent leads.

ethan: Love the small-launch angle. Propose we headline around "operational wins" rather than raw multipliers. Engineers respond better to concrete levers (batch sizes, prefix cache).

maya: Agreed. Hero should show an operational lever on the x-axis (batch size / cache on/off) and cost-per-response on y. Keep model family and hardware called out in caption.

maria: For the three charts, what if we do: 1) hero — lever vs $/1k responses (line), 2) tail risk — p50/p95/p99 shaded comparison (area) across configs, 3) practical throughput — RPS vs $ per 1000 responses (bars by batch size). Short captions + assumptions.

leo: Routing: add two inbound signals that bump priority — downloaded full benchmark PDF, or submitted the "run your slice" form with a company domain. If either true, AE+SE outreach. Otherwise standard nurture.

ethan: Microcopy testing — try these variants on modal CTA: A) "Run your slice on Redwood Dedicated" B) "See your token dollars with our quick eval" C) "Benchmark your app in 10 minutes". Track demo signups and pdp->contact rate.

maya: Webinar format: 8m findings, 10m demo (copy-paste commands + results), 7m Q&A + CTA. Demo must include exact shell commands and a tiny eval script snippet.

maria: On claims: avoid absolute multipliers in headline. Use conditional phrasing: "In our testbed, enabling batch+cache reduced per-response cost up to 4x; typical slices see 1.5x-2.5x." Put full methodology link in the PDF footer.

leo: I'll draft routing rules and a small JSON sample for product. Quick rules: if (form_run_slice == true OR clicked_pdf == true) AND company_size > 100 -> AE outreach; if webinar_attendee AND job_title contains (infra|ml|platform) -> solutions SE follow-up; else nurture.

ethan: Chart callouts: mark typical chat (512 tokens) and long-context indexing (2048 tokens). Also add a tiny note: hardware=A100 v3 equivalent.

maya: Who wants the two-paragraph blog lead? Keep it punchy and engineer-focused. I can draft but low on cycles — can someone take a stab?

maria: I'll write the blog lead and the PDF outline. Will keep it mechanical: what we measured, how we measured it, what levers moved the needle.

ops-bot: Webinar scheduled: https://cal.link/redwood-mini-bench  slots: Wed 10am / Thu 2pm.

maya: Nice. Action list: maria -> blog lead + PDF outline; ethan -> chart mocks (SVGs) + demo commands; leo -> routing JSON + event mapping; maya -> webinar run-of-show + sample script. Target: rough drafts in 36 hours.

ethan: I'll push SVGs and a tiny eval script snippet (bash + python) to the marketing folder by EOD.

maria: Good. Keep copy evidence-backed and avoid hype. Tag the repo with a methodology.md link in the PDF.

maya: Thanks team  any blockers ping here. We'll iterate microcopy after we see early CTRs. :thumbsup:
